semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Acro Chemical Corporation specializes in activated carbon products that are relevant for liquid and gas treatment in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Acro Chemical Corporation is a Taiwanese company that manufactures and reactivates activated carbon, focusing on environmental protection and treatment solutions. With over 30 years of experience, they provide customized activated carbon products suitable for various industries, including the semiconductor sector.
